To amend the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to establish within the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency the National Cyber and AI Investigations Board to investigate significant cyber incidents, cyber incidents involving terrorism, and cyber incidents involving artificial intelligence, to determine root causes and develop recommendations to prevent similar incidents and address terrorism threats to the United States, including threats relating to the malicious use of information systems or artificial intelligence by covered foreign adversaries, including terrorist organizations, and for other purposes.

To establish a climate resilience workforce, and for other purposes.

To provide for the establishment of a U.S.-Kenya Agricultural and Critical Minerals Trade Partnership.

To extend and improve expiring prepared and response authorities of the Department of Health and Human Services.

A bill to amend title 10, United States Code, to expedite specialty care referrals for members of the Armed Forces and beneficiaries under the TRICARE program who are undergoing a permanent change of station, and for other purposes.

A bill to require the Director of the Office of Personnel Management to carry out a research program and demonstration project to study and test modernized methods of classifying positions and compensating employees of the Federal Government, and for other purposes.

A bill to provide for certain maps relating to the availability of broadband service and funding for broadband infrastructure deployment to be consolidated into a single online mapping tool, to provide for certain improvements with respect to broadband mapping data, and for other purposes.

A bill to require the Administrator of the Drug Enforcement Administration to temporarily exempt buprenorphine from the Suspicious Orders Report System for the remainder of the opioid public health emergency.
A bill to require the timely submission of a detailed incident report with respect to every death of any person while in the custody of the Department of Homeland Security.
A bill to require the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue rules relating to the use of artificial intelligence by public companies, and for other purposes.

A bill to authorize assistance to support activities relating to the clearance of land mines, unexploded ordnance, and other explosive remnants of war in Cambodia, Laos, and Vietnam, to recognize the refugee and immigrant communities that supported and defended the United States Armed Forces during the conflict in Southeast Asia in the 1960s and 1970s, including Hmong, Cham, Cambodian, Iu Mien, Khmu, Lao, Montagnard, and Vietnamese Americans, and for other purposes.

A bill to amend title XIX of the Social Security Act to revise the definition of institution for mental diseases under the Medicaid program to exclude institutions of 17 to 32 beds that meet certain standards.
A bill to amend the Indian Health Care Improvement Act to authorize a special behavioral health program for Indians, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to provide for additional disclosure requirements for certain communications, and for other purposes.
A bill to establish ethics, transparency, and accountability requirements relating to equity interests held by Federal agencies, and for other purposes.
A bill to enhance safety and security at federally licensed gun shops, and for other purposes.
A bill to increase the Government-wide goal for participation by small business concerns owned and controlled by women in Federal prime contracting, and for other purposes.
A bill to help prevent suicide by giving people more control over their own lethal means purchase decisions, through the creation of a voluntary purchase delay database.
A bill to ensure merit-based promotions, and for other purposes.

A bill to amend the Public Health Service Act to authorize grants to States, Indian Tribes, Tribal organizations, and political subdivisions thereof to hire, employ, train, and dispatch mental health professionals to respond in lieu of law enforcement officers in emergencies involving one or more persons with a mental illness or an intellectual or developmental disability, and for other purposes.
A bill to establish Federal research award reimbursement limits for indirect costs for institutions of higher education, and for other purposes.
A bill to require the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish a demonstration project to increase access to biosimilar biological products under the Medicare program.
A bill to protect minors from premature waiver of their constitutional rights during a custodial interrogation, and for other purposes.
A bill to reform pattern or practice investigations conducted by the Department of Justice, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention Act of 1974 to eliminate the use of valid court orders to secure lockup of status offenders, and for other purposes.
A bill to enhance coverage and oversight of occupational safety and health standards in correctional facilities, and for other purposes.
A bill to authorize appropriations for occupational education and training programs of the Bureau of Prisons, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend title 28, United States Code, to require the Federal Judicial Center to release certain information.
A bill to establish a grant to provide mental and behavioral health services and diversion programs to at-risk youth, and for other purposes.
A bill to prevent discrimination and retaliation against incarcerated workers, and for other purposes.

A bill to provide definitions of terms and services related to community-based gang intervention to ensure that funding for such intervention is utilized in a cost-effective manner and that community-based agencies are held accountable for providing holistic, integrated intervention services, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend title 5, United States Code, to address the availability of information, and for other purposes.

A bill to amend the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 to allow individuals with drug offenses to receive benefits under the supplemental nutrition assistance program, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to extend the advanced manufacturing investment credit.
A bill to expand reporting on subcontracts and subgrants made under Federal awards, and for other purposes.
A bill to reauthorize the Junior Duck Stamp Conservation and Design Program Act of 1994, and for other purposes.

A bill to amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to permanently extend the authority of the Secretary of Health and Human Services to award priority review vouchers for rare pediatric disease products.
A bill to establish protections for passengers in air transportation, and for other purposes.

A bill to convert the program of public financing of presidential election campaigns to a program for providing grants to States for enhancing the security of election systems, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the Agriculture Improvement Act of 2018 with respect to micro-grants for food security, and for other purposes.
A bill to require the Environmental Protection Agency to carry out a study to better understand the environmental impacts of wildland fires, and for other purposes.

A bill to authorize an extension of a program to permit screened passengers and their property arriving on direct flights or flight segments originating at certain foreign last point of departure airports to continue on additional flights or flight segments originating in the United States without additional screening, and for other purposes.

A bill to amend title 28, United States Code, to authorize additional judges for the circuit and district courts, to require a study on the composition of certain judicial circuits, and for other purposes.

A bill to establish Governmentwide requirements for pre-payment fraud prevention actions, to provide the U.S. Treasury appropriate data resources, to facilitate participation in Governmentwide anti-fraud data sharing, and for other purposes.
